title: Brief voltage drops followed by recovery
description: Two source-side dips: a 100 ms dip to 0.55 pu (shorter than one report, visible only in the per-cycle minimum) and a 600 ms dip to 0.60 pu (lowers the report average).
what_to_look_for: Feeder shows 'Brief voltage dip' twice, then returns to NORMAL each time.
Two TRANSIENT_DIP events, each grouping all three nodes (a source dip is seen everywhere).
No UNDERVOLTAGE or interruption event: the dips clear before the persistence time.
The first event says its duration is unknown (below report resolution).
